title: Repository standards manifest (.claude/standards.json)
description: Structure only. The rules a schema cannot state are enforced by scripts/check-standards.js and listed in references/standards.md: check names are unique; each rule's doc file part is a tracked file; each paths glob matches at least one tracked file; a rule's check names a check; the preamble is a tracked file.

doc.description: Repo-relative path to a tracked file, with an optional #fragment.

paths.description: Globs over tracked files: ** any depth, * within one segment. null is the same as absent.

check.description: The name of a check, or null (reported as a warning).

preamble.description: Repo-relative path to a tracked file. null is the same as absent.
